experience_type: Editorial scrollytelling + explorable data, not a dashboard and not a conventional report website.
avoid: decorative charts with no narrative purpose
visual_metaphors: job as a bundle of tasks
value flow from productivity to wages/company/customer
colour_direction: Use a restrained neutral base with one AI/system accent, one human/expertise accent and one caution accent. Google AI Studio has freedom to choose accessible exact colours; maintain semantic consistency across the whole experience.
type_direction: Use an expressive display face for chapter statements paired with a highly legible body/UI face. Coder may choose suitable Google Fonts; prioritize readability and data labels over novelty.
motion: Motion should explain change: task decomposition, ladder transformation, value flow and progressive reveal. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Avoid gratuitous parallax/3D.
accessibility: never encode meaning using colour alone
creative_freedom: The coder may reinterpret composition, typography, motion and micro-interactions, but may not change claim values, claim semantics, source relationships, caveats, or the six-chapter narrative logic without explicit approval.
